spans.s: कौल (I) a. (f. ली) 1. Relating to a family, ancestral; 2. of a noble family, well-born.
कौल (II) m. A worshipper of शक्ति according to the left hand ritual.
कौल (II) n. The doctrine and practices of the left hand Śāktas.
कौल (I) a. (f. ली) 1. Relating to a family, ancestral; 2. of a noble family, well-born.
कौलकेय m. The son of a disloyal wife.
कौलटिनेय m. The son of a chaste female beggar.
कौलटेय m. The son of a female beggar chaste or unchaste.
कौलिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Belonging to a family; 2. customary in a family.
कौलिक (II) m. 1. A weaver; 2. a heretic; 3. a follower of the left hand Śākta ritual.
कौलिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Belonging to a family; 2. customary in a family.
कौलीन (I) a. (f. ना) Belonging to a noble family.
कौलीन (II) m. 1. The son of a female beggar; 2. a left hand Śākta.

कौलीन (III) n. 1. An evil report, a scandal, कौलीममात्माश्रयमाचचक्षे R.xiv.; 36, 84, मा कौलीनादसितनयने मय्यविश्वासिनी भूः Megh.ii.49; 2. an improper act, bad conduct, ख्याते तस्मिन् वितमसि कुले जन्म कौलीनमेतत् Ve.ii.; 3. a combat of animals; 4. war, battle; 5. The pudenda; 6. high birth.
कौलीन (I) a. (f. ना) Belonging to a noble family.
कौलीन्य n. 1. High birth; 2. family scandal.
कौलूत m. A king of Kulūtas, कौलूताश्चित्रवर्मा Mud.i.
कौल्य a. (f. ल्या) Nobly born, of a high birth.
कौल्य a. (f. ल्या) Nobly born, of a high birth.
